paragraphs.source_en: Ishida Mitsunari was about to be taken under guard from Ōtsu to the capital. The war clouds that had shrouded heaven and earth were gradually dispersing, and clear skies appeared once more.

units.source_en: Ishida Mitsunari was about to be taken under guard from Ōtsu to the capital. The war clouds that had shrouded heaven and earth were gradually dispersing, and clear skies appeared once more.

ja.t: されることになっていた。

units.source_zh: 石田三成即将从大津押赴京城，笼罩天地的战争阴云正在逐渐散去，晴空重又显现。

paragraphs.source_zh: 石田三成即将从大津押赴京城，笼罩天地的战争阴云正在逐渐散去，晴空重又显现。

paragraphs.source_en: Nor was it only along the Tōkaidō. On the Nakasendō, Hideyoshi had transferred Sengoku Gonbei to Komoro in Shinano and charged him with guarding the perilous Usui Pass. He had also won over Sanada Awa-no-kami and his son, stationing strong forces at such vital passes as Kawanakajima and Kiso to block Ieyasu's advance westward. The defenses seemed utterly impregnable.

units.source_en: Nor was it only along the Tōkaidō. On the Nakasendō, Hideyoshi had transferred Sengoku Gonbei to Komoro in Shinano and charged him with guarding the perilous Usui Pass.
units.source_zh: 不只东海道一线，在中山道，秀吉又把仙石权兵卫转封到信州的小诸，让他镇守碓冰之险。

units.source_en: He had also won over Sanada Awa-no-kami and his son, stationing strong forces at such vital passes as Kawanakajima and Kiso to block Ieyasu's advance westward.
units.source_zh: 他还把真田安房守父子拉拢过来，在川中岛、木曾等重要关隘设重兵防卫，以阻家康西进。

units.source_en: The defenses seemed utterly impregnable.
units.source_zh: 防御之牢固，可谓万无一失。

paragraphs.source_zh: 不只东海道一线，在中山道，秀吉又把仙石权兵卫转封到信州的小诸，让他镇守碓冰之险。他还把真田安房守父子拉拢过来，在川中岛、木曾等重要关隘设重兵防卫，以阻家康西进。防御之牢固，可谓万无一失。

paragraphs.source_en: Later, Hideyoshi transferred Gamō Ujisato to Aizu. Before long, however, Ujisato's son Hideyuki became Ieyasu's son-in-law, forcing Hideyoshi to install Uesugi Kagekatsu in Aizu instead and move Hori Kyūtarō into the Uesugi family's former domain of Echigo. Everything he did sprang from his deep fear of Ieyasu.

units.source_en: Later, Hideyoshi transferred Gamō Ujisato to Aizu.
units.source_zh: 后来，秀吉又把蒲生氏乡转封会津。

units.source_en: Before long, however, Ujisato's son Hideyuki became Ieyasu's son-in-law, forcing Hideyoshi to install Uesugi Kagekatsu in Aizu instead and move Hori Kyūtarō into the Uesugi family's former domain of Echigo.
units.source_zh: 不久，由于氏乡之子秀行成了家康女婿，秀吉又不得不把上杉景胜封至会津，并把堀久太郎调到上杉旧领越后。

units.source_en: Everything he did sprang from his deep fear of Ieyasu.
units.source_zh: 所有的一切，都是因为他对家康惧三分。

paragraphs.source_zh: 后来，秀吉又把蒲生氏乡转封会津。不久，由于氏乡之子秀行成了家康女婿，秀吉又不得不把上杉景胜封至会津，并把堀久太郎调到上杉旧领越后。所有的一切，都是因为他对家康惧三分。

paragraphs.source_en: Hideyoshi's fear of Ieyasu became a chronic affliction, yet everything he did was also meant to fulfill his lifelong aspiration of bringing peace to the realm. It was therefore hardly surprising that Hideyoshi's fear and distrust of Ieyasu should pass intact to Ishida Mitsunari, his closest favorite.

units.source_en: Hideyoshi's fear of Ieyasu became a chronic affliction, yet everything he did was also meant to fulfill his lifelong aspiration of bringing peace to the realm.

ja.t: となったが、そのすべては

units.source_zh: 秀吉对家康的畏惧成为顽疾，但一切又无不是为了实现他“天下太平”的平生夙愿。

units.source_en: It was therefore hardly surprising that Hideyoshi's fear and distrust of Ieyasu should pass intact to Ishida Mitsunari, his closest favorite.
units.source_zh: 故，秀吉对家康的恐惧和不信任，被他最亲近的宠臣石田三成原封不动继承下来，实在不足为奇。

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀吉对家康的畏惧成为顽疾，但一切又无不是为了实现他“天下太平”的平生夙愿。故，秀吉对家康的恐惧和不信任，被他最亲近的宠臣石田三成原封不动继承下来，实在不足为奇。

paragraphs.source_en: After years at Hideyoshi's side, Mitsunari had unconsciously sensed the resentment and fear hidden in his master's heart. Yet instead of recognizing them as Hideyoshi's influence, he mistook them for his own farsighted wisdom. Thus blinded, he saw every act of Ieyasu's as a malicious conspiracy against the Toyotomi house.

units.source_en: After years at Hideyoshi's side, Mitsunari had unconsciously sensed the resentment and fear hidden in his master's heart. Yet instead of recognizing them as Hideyoshi's influence, he mistook them for his own farsighted wisdom.
units.source_zh: 在秀吉身边多年，三成不知不觉察知了藏在秀吉心中的怨恨和恐惧，但他并未把这一切理解为秀吉的影响，而是当成自己的远见卓识。

units.source_en: Thus blinded, he saw every act of Ieyasu's as a malicious conspiracy against the Toyotomi house.
units.source_zh: 他的双眼因此被蒙蔽，把家康的一切举动都看成不利丰臣氏的阴谋祸心。

paragraphs.source_zh: 在秀吉身边多年，三成不知不觉察知了藏在秀吉心中的怨恨和恐惧，但他并未把这一切理解为秀吉的影响，而是当成自己的远见卓识。他的双眼因此被蒙蔽，把家康的一切举动都看成不利丰臣氏的阴谋祸心。

paragraphs.source_en: Mitsunari inherited Hideyoshi's weaknesses; Ieyasu learned from his strengths. The lesson concealed here truly merits deep reflection. Mitsunari was no mediocrity, but his loyalty extended only to the Toyotomi house. Compare what he and Ieyasu each drew from Hideyoshi, and the gulf between them becomes plain. The Battle of Sekigahara was their confrontation.

units.source_en: Mitsunari inherited Hideyoshi's weaknesses; Ieyasu learned from his strengths.
units.source_zh: 三成继承了秀吉之短，家康则汲取秀吉之长。

units.source_en: The lesson concealed here truly merits deep reflection.

ja.t: えさせられるものがある。

units.source_zh: 此中隐藏着的教训，实当令人深思。

units.source_en: Mitsunari was no mediocrity, but his loyalty extended only to the Toyotomi house.
units.source_zh: 三成绝非平庸之辈，但他只对丰臣氏忠心耿耿。

units.source_en: Compare what he and Ieyasu each drew from Hideyoshi, and the gulf between them becomes plain.
units.source_zh: 比较一下他和家康从秀吉处汲取来的东西，自会发现其天壤之别。

units.source_en: The Battle of Sekigahara was their confrontation.
units.source_zh: 关原合战便是他们之间的对决。

paragraphs.source_zh: 三成继承了秀吉之短，家康则汲取秀吉之长。此中隐藏着的教训，实当令人深思。三成绝非平庸之辈，但他只对丰臣氏忠心耿耿。比较一下他和家康从秀吉处汲取来的东西，自会发现其天壤之别。关原合战便是他们之间的对决。

paragraphs.source_en: Advancing along the Nakasendō, Tokugawa Hidetada met serious resistance only from Sanada Masayuki at Ueda; even so, on the twentieth day of the ninth month of Keichō 5, he reached Kusatsu in Ōmi safely and joined Ieyasu's main army.

units.source_en: Advancing along the Nakasendō, Tokugawa Hidetada met serious resistance only from Sanada Masayuki at Ueda; even so, on the twentieth day of the ninth month of Keichō 5, he reached Kusatsu in Ōmi safely and joined Ieyasu's main army.

ja.t: によるものだけだった。それでも

units.source_zh: 中山道的德川秀忠，在途中遇到的像样抵抗，只来自上田的真田昌幸，但庆长五年九月二十，秀忠仍顺利抵达近江草津，与家康大军会师。

paragraphs.source_zh: 中山道的德川秀忠，在途中遇到的像样抵抗，只来自上田的真田昌幸，但庆长五年九月二十，秀忠仍顺利抵达近江草津，与家康大军会师。

paragraphs.source_en: That same day, Ieyasu sent Ōno Harunaga, who had submitted to the Eastern Army, to Osaka to report the victory to Lady Yodo and Hideyori.

units.source_en: That same day, Ieyasu sent Ōno Harunaga, who had submitted to the Eastern Army, to Osaka to report the victory to Lady Yodo and Hideyori.
units.source_zh: 同日，家康把归附了东军的大野治长派往大坂，向淀夫人和秀赖汇报战果。

paragraphs.source_zh: 同日，家康把归附了东军的大野治长派往大坂，向淀夫人和秀赖汇报战果。

paragraphs.source_en: The message brought tears to Ōno Harunaga's eyes; it was sincere and heartfelt, without the slightest trace of falsehood.

units.source_en: The message brought tears to Ōno Harunaga's eyes; it was sincere and heartfelt, without the slightest trace of falsehood.

ja.t: りはひとかけらもなかった。

units.source_zh: 一席话说得大野治长眼圈发红，这口信真挚诚恳，无一丝虚情假意。

paragraphs.source_zh: 一席话说得大野治长眼圈发红，这口信真挚诚恳，无一丝虚情假意。

paragraphs.source_en: On the twenty-fifth day of the ninth month, Ōno Harunaga hurried back to Ōtsu with envoys from Lady Yodo and Hideyori. One can readily imagine how delighted Lady Yodo and her son must have been to hear Ieyasu's message. Ieyasu was not yet ready to depart; he wished to devote himself to designing an entirely new map of the realm.

units.source_en: On the twenty-fifth day of the ninth month, Ōno Harunaga hurried back to Ōtsu with envoys from Lady Yodo and Hideyori.
units.source_zh: 九月二十五，大野治长带着淀夫人和秀赖的使者，急急返回大津。

units.source_en: One can readily imagine how delighted Lady Yodo and her son must have been to hear Ieyasu's message.
units.source_zh: 不难想象，听了家康口信，淀夫人母子必甚是高兴。

units.source_en: Ieyasu was not yet ready to depart; he wished to devote himself to designing an entirely new map of the realm.

units.source_zh: 家康还不想动身，他要专心致志构思全新版图。

paragraphs.source_zh: 九月二十五，大野治长带着淀夫人和秀赖的使者，急急返回大津。不难想象，听了家康口信，淀夫人母子必甚是高兴。家康还不想动身，他要专心致志构思全新版图。

paragraphs.source_en: At Ieyasu's headquarters in Ōtsu, urgent reports and messengers arrived ceaselessly from every quarter. After Uesugi Kagekatsu was challenged by the Date and Mogami clans, he had to meet that threat and could do no more than face Yūki Hideyasu without engaging him. Now Shōdai of Hōkōji repeatedly urged him to make peace with Yūki Hideyasu.

units.source_en: At Ieyasu's headquarters in Ōtsu, urgent reports and messengers arrived ceaselessly from every quarter.
units.source_zh: 大津，家康帅营，来自各地的急报和使者络绎不绝。

units.source_en: After Uesugi Kagekatsu was challenged by the Date and Mogami clans, he had to meet that threat and could do no more than face Yūki Hideyasu without engaging him.

units.source_zh: 由于上杉景胜后来受伊达氏和最上氏的挑战，为了应战，他只能与结城秀康对峙，而不与之交火。

units.source_en: Now Shōdai of Hōkōji repeatedly urged him to make peace with Yūki Hideyasu.
units.source_zh: 而如今，丰光寺承兑又频频向他进言，奉劝他向结城秀康求和。

paragraphs.source_zh: 大津，家康帅营，来自各地的急报和使者络绎不绝。由于上杉景胜后来受伊达氏和最上氏的挑战，为了应战，他只能与结城秀康对峙，而不与之交火。而如今，丰光寺承兑又频频向他进言，奉劝他向结城秀康求和。

paragraphs.source_en: In Kyushu, Kuroda Nagamasa's father Josui saw this golden opportunity and immediately poured his lifetime's savings into recruiting great numbers of rōnin, extending his reach even into Bungo, Chikuzen, and Chikugo. To that end, he also wrote a letter to Tōdō Takatora, who enjoyed Ieyasu's deep trust:

units.source_en: In Kyushu, Kuroda Nagamasa's father Josui saw this golden opportunity and immediately poured his lifetime's savings into recruiting great numbers of rōnin, extending his reach even into Bungo, Chikuzen, and Chikugo.

units.source_en: To that end, he also wrote a letter to Tōdō Takatora, who enjoyed Ieyasu's deep trust:

paragraphs.source_zh: 九州，黑田长政之父如水看到这一绝好机会，立刻倾尽平生积蓄，大肆招揽浪人，甚至把手伸向丰后、筑前、筑后。为此，他还给深得家康信任的藤堂高虎写了一封书函：

paragraphs.source_en: > I wish to make the lands I have taken on this occasion my family's estate, and humbly ask your generous understanding. My unworthy son holds a fief in the Kinai, but though I have retired, I must still provide for my livelihood; I therefore beg your kind consideration. My long friendship with you, my lord, has been for the sake of this very day...

units.source_en: > I wish to make the lands I have taken on this occasion my family's estate, and humbly ask your generous understanding.
units.source_zh: > 此次所取土地，想置为家业，还请多多宽谅。

units.source_en: My unworthy son holds a fief in the Kinai, but though I have retired, I must still provide for my livelihood; I therefore beg your kind consideration.

paragraphs.source_en: If even Josui was so brazen, Katō Kiyomasa, whose domain bordered Konishi Yukinaga's, was hardly going to remain idle; he too was voraciously devouring Konishi's territory.

paragraphs.source_en: In the northern provinces, Maeda Toshinaga pressed the remnants of the Western Army ever harder. Hosokawa Tadaoki's father Yūsai, though already sixty-seven, had fought on alone and thereby preserved the Hosokawa holdings in Tango.

units.source_en: In the northern provinces, Maeda Toshinaga pressed the remnants of the Western Army ever harder.

paragraphs.source_zh: 在北国，前田利长向西军残部步步紧逼。细川忠兴之父幽斋，尽管已是六十七岁高龄，还是孤军奋战，方保住了细川氏在丹后的领地。

paragraphs.source_en: Natsuka Masaie and his younger brother Iga-no-kami, who had fled from Mount Nangū back to Minakuchi Castle, found themselves with nowhere left to turn, and on the thirtieth day of the ninth month Masaie finally took his own life. Tachibana Muneshige, Mitsunari's ally who had come from Yanagawa in Kyushu, saw that Mōri Terumoto and Mashita Nagamori had no intention of defending Ōtsu and promptly withdrew.

units.source_zh: 作为三成盟军，从九州柳川赶来的立花宗茂，看到毛利辉元和增田长盛并无守大津之意，二话不说便撤了回去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 从南宫山逃回水口城的长束正家与其弟伊贺守，走投无路，正家终于九月三十自杀。作为三成盟军，从九州柳川赶来的立花宗茂，看到毛利辉元和增田长盛并无守大津之意，二话不说便撤了回去。

paragraphs.source_en: Only Shimazu Yoshihiro, who had cut a bloody path out of Sekigahara toward Ise, later managed with great difficulty to escape alone to Osaka, then withdrew by ship to his domain of Satsuma. Although Ukita Hideie was still nowhere to be found, the outcome was already settled.

units.source_en: Only Shimazu Yoshihiro, who had cut a bloody path out of Sekigahara toward Ise, later managed with great difficulty to escape alone to Osaka, then withdrew by ship to his domain of Satsuma.
units.source_zh: 只有从关原杀出一条血路前往伊势的岛津义弘，后来好不容易独自逃回大坂，然后乘船撤回领地萨摩。

units.source_en: Although Ukita Hideie was still nowhere to be found, the outcome was already settled.

paragraphs.source_en: Seeing that the issue was decided, court nobles and wealthy merchants in Kyoto and Osaka sent representatives to Ōtsu one after another to “congratulate” Ieyasu on his great victory.

units.source_en: Seeing that the issue was decided, court nobles and wealthy merchants in Kyoto and Osaka sent representatives to Ōtsu one after another to “congratulate” Ieyasu on his great victory.

paragraphs.source_en: On the twentieth day of the ninth month, Ieyasu ordered every residence belonging to Western Army commanders at Fushimi Castle demolished.

paragraphs.source_en: On the twenty-second, Ieyasu ordered Fukushima Masanori, Ikeda Terumasa, Asano Yoshinaga, Tōdō Takatora, Arima Toyouji, and others to advance to Kuzuha and hold Osaka in check. His sole purpose was to watch Mōri Terumoto, whose intentions remained unclear as he stayed in Osaka's Nishinomaru.

units.source_en: On the twenty-second, Ieyasu ordered Fukushima Masanori, Ikeda Terumasa, Asano Yoshinaga, Tōdō Takatora, Arima Toyouji, and others to advance to Kuzuha and hold Osaka in check.
units.source_zh: 二十二日，家康命福岛正则、池田辉政、浅野幸长、藤堂高虎、有马丰氏等人开赴葛叶，以牵制大坂。

units.source_en: His sole purpose was to watch Mōri Terumoto, whose intentions remained unclear as he stayed in Osaka's Nishinomaru.
units.source_zh: 目的只有一个，便是冷观身在大坂西苑、态度还不明朗的毛利辉元。

paragraphs.source_zh: 二十二日，家康命福岛正则、池田辉政、浅野幸长、藤堂高虎、有马丰氏等人开赴葛叶，以牵制大坂。目的只有一个，便是冷观身在大坂西苑、态度还不明朗的毛利辉元。

paragraphs.source_en: Learning that the Eastern Army commanders had reached Kuzuha, Terumoto hastily sent pledges to Ii Naomasa, Honda Tadakatsu, Fukushima Masanori, Kuroda Nagamasa, and the others: “I shall withdraw from the Nishinomaru, thereby demonstrating that I harbor no divided loyalties.”

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu neither agreed nor disagreed. Yet whatever Terumoto chose to do, Ieyasu was not at all concerned. The former Toyotomi commanders alone had won the great victory at Sekigahara. Even if the Mōri clan possessed three heads and six arms, would it still dare oppose Ieyasu?
